title: Childhood sighting of a wobbling reddish-orange light

tellings.quote: and uh I had one sighting myself uh when I was about 12 and um I was looking out of my bedroom window and I saw this kind of reddish orange glowing light and it was moving in an arc from there to the horizon

plain: Around 1976, in the UK, a twelve-year-old looked out of his bedroom window and saw a reddish-orange glowing light moving in an arc down to the horizon. The boy was Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who says he later found signs of a secret space programme inside the files of NASA, the US space agency. He tells it as the one sighting he had himself.
